name: Hyper ground bounce: a hyper, then a down dash and a jump in it
techNote: A metal floor (top y 0). Jump, dash down-right with jump on dash frame 4: the hyper on tick 7 (547 up, 1650 momentum right). Stick at rest; 9 input ticks later (the dash cooldown) dash straight down with jump on dash frame 2: the landing ends the down dash, and endDash gives back 95 % of preDashMomentum.x (dashDirection.y == -1) and sets DashBounceFrames, so the buffered jump is the ground bounce (805 up + 600 momentum up) with the hyper's momentum: 1736.7 right after the bounce tick (tick 22), where a ground bounce alone has 0. It is in the finish box (x 821 to 921, y 250 to 350) on its way up.
